The steady velocity profile is linear across the gap.
Use u(y) = U * y / h, where y is measured from the stationary bottom plate.
Set U = 5 m/s and h = 10 mm.
The bottom plate velocity is 0 m/s.
The top plate velocity is 5 m/s.
The velocity increases linearly from 0 m/s at the bottom plate to 5 m/s at the top plate.
There is no pressure gradient in the flow direction.
